timeframe: 1995 Outer Heaven Uprising, Operation Intrude N313; no later-game character events included
source_priority: J2ME 3.3.0 target still unverified; MSX2 1987 comparative; subsequent titles hindsight

character_timelines.name: Solid Snake
character_timelines.initial_status: Follows his CO and relies on authoritative instructions
character_timelines.motivation: Find Gray Fox, investigate and destroy Metal Gear
character_timelines.central_pressure: Trust in his mentor and command versus the evidence he must act on himself
character_timelines.turning_point: Rescues Fox, confronts manipulated guidance, earns relationships beyond chain of command
character_timelines.final_1995_status: Defeats the Outer Heaven leader and escapes without uncritical reliance on command
character_timelines.source_boundary: No knowledge of Big Boss's later-canon identity retcon while playing the 1995 mission

sequence.story_action: Gray Fox infiltrates the South African fortress and is lost after his final Metal Gear transmission. Big Boss chooses rookie Snake for Intrude N313.
sequence.character_function: The elite's disappearance makes the rookie assignment ominous; the commander keeps his ownership of the fortress hidden.

sequence.story_action: Snake arrives alone with transceiver, receives rescue and destroy objectives.
sequence.character_function: Initial obedience and isolation, with practical command credibility.

sequence.story_action: Snake gets ration/Card 1/binoculars at initial trucks while observing sentry routine.
sequence.character_function: Equipment is earned, not issued; the place presents first moral/survival choices.

sequence.story_action: Gas Mask behind Card 1 door; resistance architect offers useful location advice.
sequence.character_function: Schneider becomes trustworthy because what he says can be checked physically.

sequence.story_action: Later truck compound offers handgun without initial ammo and land mines.
sequence.character_function: The player cannot simply solve every obstacle by firing.

sequence.story_action: 3F ammo, prisoners, keycards and further equipment; 2F cameras and security routes. POW information introduces Diane; Steve can answer Japanese-version calls.
sequence.character_function: Unknown allies become differentiated voices: soldier, architect, boss expert.

sequence.story_action: Prisoners point to Gray Fox's secret solitary cell and suggest capture as the way in.
sequence.character_function: What looks like a mistake becomes an intentional high-risk plan.

sequence.story_action: Snake is apprehended on the appropriate route; weapons and equipment confiscated.
sequence.character_function: Trusting the mission entails genuine vulnerability.

sequence.story_action: Snake detects hollow masonry and crosses into Fox's cell.
sequence.character_function: Player solves physical problem and meets the missing elite as a captive.

sequence.story_action: Gray Fox explains nuclear-capable Metal Gear and names Dr. Pettrovich as source of weakness.
sequence.character_function: Experienced operative gives Snake his true mission, with the personal cost of his imprisonment.

sequence.story_action: Recover seized gear and confront Shotmaker/Shoot Gunner defending escape.
sequence.character_function: The prior disarmed protagonist earns the first major combat victory.

sequence.story_action: Return from prison through upper routes, save further prisoners, access hidden equipment and new keycards.
sequence.character_function: Fox's intel carries forward despite his departure.

sequence.story_action: Machinegun Kid dominates a defended line; player finds angle/cover solution.
sequence.character_function: Boss-specific learned counterplay replaces hit-point inflation.

sequence.story_action: Roof route, parachute and Hind D helicopter confrontation.
sequence.character_function: From building security to militarized air defense.

sequence.story_action: Tank engagement and disguise checkpoint; commander and architect offer practical access tips.
sequence.character_function: Big Boss still sometimes helps, making late betrayal stronger.

sequence.story_action: Bulldozer blocks route to deeper research wing.
sequence.character_function: Machinery is part of working fortress infrastructure.

sequence.story_action: Fire Trooper contests a protected passage.
sequence.character_function: The mercenaries' old military skills are revealed through their encounters.

sequence.story_action: Misleading scientist location leads Snake into a trap; actual Madnar held elsewhere.
sequence.character_function: Not all intelligence is reliable, unlike physical evidence.

sequence.story_action: Freed POWs identify medical staff resistance agent Jennifer; source requires sufficient rank for contact.
sequence.character_function: Rescuing strangers builds enough trust that a hidden insider risks talking.

sequence.story_action: Jennifer arranges rocket launcher; two TX-11 Arnolds guard Card 7.
sequence.character_function: The engineer's other weapons now impede rescue; medical insider's aid becomes decisive.

sequence.story_action: Snake finds real Madnar. Engineer says his daughter is captive and refuses to discuss Metal Gear until freed.
sequence.character_function: Frustrating to Snake but emotionally justified: father will not risk daughter's life.

sequence.story_action: Snake deliberately navigates back to Building One through gas, darkness, basement traps and the earlier detention architecture.
sequence.character_function: Backtracking is no longer a chore: Snake revisits the site with a new reason.

sequence.story_action: Snake hears Ellen through a wall, breaches it and releases her.
sequence.character_function: Two captives rescued from adjacent history of the same facility; visible human cost of engineering project.

sequence.story_action: Ellen confirms father was forced to develop the weapon and asks Snake to help him.
sequence.character_function: She is a witness with her own words, not a keycard.

sequence.story_action: Snake returns to Madnar, conveys Ellen's safety; engineer gives Metal Gear location in Building Three and destruction method.
sequence.character_function: Moral action unlocks operational truth; no fabricated on-screen family reunion.

sequence.story_action: Madnar describes sixteen charges on TX-55 feet in a particular left-right sequence, though the original dialogue omits the last step.
sequence.character_function: His highly specific knowledge is indispensable and still imperfect.

sequence.story_action: Return across desert/land crossing to Building Three; truck ambush occurs.
sequence.character_function: The invasion has become a hunt; earlier safe routes are no longer secure.

sequence.story_action: Big Boss advises a dangerous truck, then a suspect door during pursuit.
sequence.character_function: The player can now independently catch command in a lie.

sequence.story_action: Jennifer helps Snake find an oxygen cylinder; underwater link yields access to a previously inaccessible wing.
sequence.character_function: Allies' earlier promises are paid off by new traversability.

sequence.story_action: Schneider begins identifying fortress commander; transmission cuts off abruptly.
sequence.character_function: The most knowledgeable ally is no longer safe; silence has consequences.

sequence.story_action: Coward Duck uses hostages as shield and carries Card 8; Jennifer warns her brother is among captives.
sequence.character_function: Correct target choice and restraint become narrative, not generic combat.

sequence.story_action: Snake rescues Jennifer's brother; freed man tells him to choose left ladder to escape.
sequence.character_function: Personal rescue seeds a specific final escape advantage.

sequence.story_action: Deep bunker prisoner states Big Boss commands Outer Heaven.
sequence.character_function: Disbelief becomes external testimony; the player earned the revelation by rescuing.

sequence.story_action: Big Boss orders Snake to abandon operation and shut down system in original platform-specific style.
sequence.character_function: Authority breaks completely; command no longer defines duty.

sequence.story_action: Snake penetrates gas, mines and electrified zones using earned equipment and allies' warnings.
sequence.character_function: Earlier tools and relationships pay off in cumulative mastery.

sequence.story_action: Snake destroys TX-55 with 16 foot charges; prior Fox and Madnar information directly enables the act.
sequence.character_function: Four arcs converge: missing operative, scientist, hostage and rookie are vindicated.

sequence.story_action: Destruction activates alarm and self-destruct countdown.
sequence.character_function: Only now do the fortress and every prior route enter a new state.

sequence.story_action: Physical commander claims Big Boss identity and reveals use of Snake to return false data; Diane cannot provide fighting solution.
sequence.character_function: The opening voice becomes personal enemy; later canon's phantom remains a behind-scenes identity.

sequence.story_action: Snake defeats commander, follows left ladder clue and escapes; Jennifer's warning adds urgency.
sequence.character_function: Earlier rescue becomes decisive rather than a side quest statistic.

sequence.story_action: Snake reports Metal Gear destruction and mission completion; fortress explodes; post-credit message threatens future meeting.
sequence.character_function: Rookie becomes self-directed survivor, while command betrayal has an unresolved legacy.
